\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 264-267 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R272-first-pass-words-from-chapters-264-267}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to drill and to leak.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to get ready, to brush, to wipe, to sweep, to fold
  \item to wrap, to light, to put out, to tie, to measure
  \item to touch, to bite, to chew, to swallow, to smell
  \item to practise, to pass, to fail, to hand over, to earn
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To get ready? (\textbf{\ml{ഒരുങ്ങുക}}, \emph{oruṅṅuka}.) To brush? (\textbf{\ml{തേക്കുക}}, \emph{tēkkuka}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\ml{തുടയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{tuṭaykkuka}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\ml{അടിച്ചുവാരുക}}, \emph{aṭiccuvāruka}.) To fold? (\textbf{\ml{മടക്കുക}}, \emph{maṭakkuka}.) To wrap? (\textbf{\ml{പൊതിയുക}}, \emph{potiyuka}.) To light? (\textbf{\ml{കത്തിക്കുക}}, \emph{kattikkuka}.) To put out? (\textbf{\ml{കെടുത്തുക}}, \emph{keṭuttuka}.) To tie? (\textbf{\ml{കെട്ടുക}}, \emph{keṭṭuka}.) To measure? (\textbf{\ml{അളക്കുക}}, \emph{aḷakkuka}.) To touch? (\textbf{\ml{തൊടുക}}, \emph{toṭuka}.) To bite? (\textbf{\ml{കടിക്കുക}}, \emph{kaṭikkuka}.) To chew? (\textbf{\ml{ചവയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{cavaykkuka}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\ml{വിഴുങ്ങുക}}, \emph{viḻuṅṅuka}.) To smell? (\textbf{\ml{മണക്കുക}}, \emph{maṇakkuka}.) To practise? (\textbf{\ml{പരിശീലിക്കുക}}, \emph{pariśīlikkuka}.) To pass? (\textbf{\ml{ജയിക്കുക}}, \emph{jayikkuka}.) To fail? (\textbf{\ml{തോൽക്കുക}}, \emph{tōlkkuka}.) To hand over? (\textbf{\ml{കൈമാറുക}}, \emph{kaimāṟuka}.) To earn? (\textbf{\ml{സമ്പാദിക്കുക}}, \emph{sampādikkuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 268-272 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R272-second-pass-words-from-chapters-268-272}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to refuse and to approve.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to refuse, to approve, to renew, to register, to deliver
  \item to comfort, to pray, to decorate, to be born, to die
  \item to oppose, to guess, to compare, to argue, to pay attention
  \item to borrow, to lend, to build, to break down, to continue
  \item to feed, to graze, to weave, to drill, to leak
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To refuse? (\textbf{\ml{നിരസിക്കുക}}, \emph{nirasikkuka}.) To approve? (\textbf{\ml{അംഗീകരിക്കുക}}, \emph{aṁgīkarikkuka}.) To renew? (\textbf{\ml{പുതുക്കുക}}, \emph{putukkuka}.) To register? (\textbf{\ml{രജിസ്റ്റർ} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{rajisṟṟar ceyyuka}.) To deliver? (\textbf{\ml{എത്തിക്കുക}}, \emph{ettikkuka}.) To comfort? (\textbf{\ml{ആശ്വസിപ്പിക്കുക}}, \emph{āśvasippikkuka}.) To pray? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുക}}, \emph{prārtthikkuka}.) To decorate? (\textbf{\ml{അലങ്കരിക്കുക}}, \emph{alaṅkarikkuka}.) To be born? (\textbf{\ml{ജനിക്കുക}}, \emph{janikkuka}.) To die? (\textbf{\ml{മരിക്കുക}}, \emph{marikkuka}.) To oppose? (\textbf{\ml{എതിർക്കുക}}, \emph{etirkkuka}.) To guess? (\textbf{\ml{ഊഹിക്കുക}}, \emph{ūhikkuka}.) To compare? (\textbf{\ml{താരതമ്യം} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{tāratamyaṁ ceyyuka}.) To argue? (\textbf{\ml{തർക്കിക്കുക}}, \emph{tarkkikkuka}.) To pay attention? (\textbf{\ml{ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക}}, \emph{śraddhikkuka}.) To borrow? (\textbf{\ml{കടം} \ml{വാങ്ങുക}}, \emph{kaṭaṁ vāṅṅuka}.) To lend? (\textbf{\ml{കടം} \ml{കൊടുക്കുക}}, \emph{kaṭaṁ koṭukkuka}.) To build? (\textbf{\ml{പണിയുക}}, \emph{paṇiyuka}.) To break down? (\textbf{\ml{കേടാകുക}}, \emph{kēṭākuka}.) To continue? (\textbf{\ml{തുടരുക}}, \emph{tuṭaruka}.) To feed? (\textbf{\ml{തീറ്റുക}}, \emph{tīṟṟuka}.) To graze? (\textbf{\ml{മേയുക}}, \emph{mēyuka}.) To weave? (\textbf{\ml{നെയ്യുക}}, \emph{neyyuka}.) To drill? (\textbf{\ml{തുളയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{tuḷaykkuka}.) To leak? (\textbf{\ml{ചോരുക}}, \emph{cōruka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
